00049 static inline const String timeToTimecodeString (const double seconds)
00050 {
00051     const double absSecs = fabs (seconds);
00052     const char* const sign = (seconds < 0) ? "-" : "";
00053  
00054     const int hours = (int) (absSecs / (60.0 * 60.0));
00055     const int mins  = ((int) (absSecs / 60.0)) % 60;
00056     const int secs  = ((int) absSecs) % 60;
00057  const int ms = roundDoubleToInt (absSecs * 1000) % 1000;
00058  
00059  const int size = 128;
00060  char buf[size];
00061  
00062  if(hours == 0)
00063  {
00064   if(mins == 0)
00065   {
00066    snprintf(buf, size, "%s%01d.%03d", sign, secs, ms);   
00067   }
00068   else
00069   {
00070    snprintf(buf, size, "%s%01d:%02d.%03d", sign, mins, secs, ms);   
00071   }
00072  }
00073  else
00074  {
00075   snprintf(buf, size, "%s%01d:%02d:%02d.%03d", sign, hours, mins, secs, ms);
00076  }
00077  
00078  return String(buf);
00079 }

00152 void ScopeComponent::paintBipolar(Graphics& g)
00153 {
00154  const int numChannels = minDrawBuffer.getNumChannels();
00155  
00156  if(numChannels > 0)
00157  {
00158   const int bufferSizeMinus1 = minDrawBuffer.size()-1;
00159   
00160   const int channelHeight = getHeight() / numChannels;
00161   const int halfChannelHeight = channelHeight / 2;
00162   
00163   const float halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum = halfChannelHeight / yMaximum;
00164    
00165   for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00166   {
00167    const int top = channelHeight * channel;
00168    const int middle = top + halfChannelHeight;
00169    const int bottom = top + channelHeight;
00170    
00171    if(channel > 0)
00172    {
00173     g.setColour(Colour(colours[TopLine].get32bitColour()));
00174     //g.drawHorizontalLine(top, 0, getWidth());
00175     g.drawLine(0, top - 0.5f, getWidth(), top - 0.5f, 1.f);
00176    }
00177    
00178    paintXScale(g, middle);
00179    paintYScale(g, middle, top);
00180    paintYScale(g, middle, bottom);
00181    
00182    float oldMinimum = clip2(minDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, 0), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum - 0.5f;
00183    float oldMaximum = clip2(maxDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, 0), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum + 0.5f;
00184    
00185    g.setColour(Colour(colours[Trace].get32bitColour()));
00186    g.drawVerticalLine(0, middle - oldMaximum, middle - oldMinimum);
00187    
00188    oldMinimum += 1.f;
00189    oldMaximum -= 1.f;
00190          
00191    for(int i = 1; i < bufferSizeMinus1; i++)
00192    {    
00193     const float minimum = clip2(minDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, i), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum;
00194     const float maximum = clip2(maxDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, i), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum;
00195     
00196     float lineTop = max(maximum, oldMinimum);
00197     float lineBottom = min(minimum, oldMaximum);
00198     
00199     if(style_ == ScopeGUI::Bars)
00200     {
00201      if(lineTop < 0.f && lineBottom < 0.f)
00202      {
00203       lineTop = 0.f;
00204       lineBottom = min(lineTop, lineBottom);
00205      }
00206      else if(lineTop > 0.f && lineBottom > 0.f)
00207      {
00208       lineTop = max(lineTop, lineBottom);
00209       lineBottom = 0.f;
00210      }
00211     }
00212     
00213     lineTop = middle - lineTop;
00214     lineBottom = middle - lineBottom;
00215         
00216     g.drawVerticalLine(i, lineTop, lineBottom);    
00217     
00218     oldMinimum = minimum + 0.5f;
00219     oldMaximum = maximum - 0.5f;
00220    }
00221    
00222    paintChannelLabel(g, channelLabels.wrapAt(channel), channel, top);
00223   }  
00224  }
00225 }

00301 void ScopeComponent::paintXScale(Graphics& g, const int y)
00302 {
00303  g.setColour(Colour(colours[ZeroLine].get32bitColour()));
00304  //g.drawHorizontalLine(y, 0, getWidth());
00305  g.drawLine(0, y - 0.5f, getWidth(), y - 0.5f, 1.f);
00306  
00307  if(scaleX != ScopeGUI::LabelXNone)
00308  {  
00309   const double audioBufferSize = audioBuffer.size();
00310   const double samplesPerPixel = (double)getDisplayBufferSize() / audioBufferSize;
00311   
00312   const int markSpacing = markSpacingX;
00313   const unsigned int labelHop = labelHopX;
00314 
00315   unsigned int mark = 0;
00316   const int labelOffsetX = 3;
00317   const int labelOffsetY = markXHeight > 5 ? 4 : markXHeight + 1;
00318   
00319   g.setFont(textSizeX);
00320   g.setColour(Colour(colours[LabelMarks].get32bitColour()));
00321   
00322   for(int audioIndex = 0; audioIndex < audioBufferSize; audioIndex += markSpacing)
00323   {   
00324    const int x = audioIndex * samplesPerPixel + 0.5;
00325    
00326    if(((labelHop <= 1) || ((mark % labelHop) == 0)))
00327    {
00328     g.drawVerticalLine(x, y - markXHeight * 1.5, y);
00329     
00330     
00331     if(scaleX != ScopeGUI::LabelXMarks && 
00332        (((mark == 0) && (labelFirstX == false)) == false)
00333     ) {
00334      String label;
00335      if(scaleX == ScopeGUI::LabelXTime)
00336      {
00337       label = timeToTimecodeString((audioIndex + offsetSamples) / UGen::getSampleRate());
00338      }
00339      else if((scaleX == ScopeGUI::LabelXFrequency) && (fftSize > 0))
00340      {
00341       const double fftFreq = UGen::getSampleRate() / fftSize;
00342       const double binFreq = (audioIndex + offsetSamples) * fftFreq;
00343       
00344       if(binFreq >= 1000.0)
00345        label = String(binFreq * 0.001, 2) + T("kHz");
00346       else
00347        label = String((int)(binFreq + 0.5)) + T("Hz");
00348      }
00349      else
00350      {
00351       label = String((int)(audioIndex + offsetSamples + 0.5));
00352      }
00353      
00354      g.setColour(Colour(colours[TextX].get32bitColour()));
00355      g.drawSingleLineText(label, x + labelOffsetX, y - labelOffsetY);
00356      g.setColour(Colour(colours[LabelMarks].get32bitColour()));
00357     }
00358    }
00359    else
00360    {
00361     g.drawVerticalLine(x, y-markXHeight, y);
00362    }
00363    
00364    mark++;
00365   }
00366   
00367  }
00368 }

00370 void ScopeComponent::paintYScale(Graphics& g, const int zero, const int maximum)
00371 { 
00372  if(scaleY != ScopeGUI::LabelYNone)
00373  {  
00374   const double markSpacing = markSpacingY;
00375   const int decimalPlaces = decimalPlacesY;
00376   const unsigned int labelHop = labelHopY;
00377   
00378   unsigned int mark = 0;
00379   const int labelOffsetX = markYWidth * 1.5 + 2;
00380   const int labelOffsetY = textSizeY / 2 + 2;
00381   
00382   const int height = zero-maximum;
00383   const double pixelFactor = (double)height / yMaximum;
00384   
00385   const double sign = height > 0 ? 1.0 : -1.0;
00386   
00387   g.setFont(textSizeY);
00388   g.setColour(Colour(colours[LabelMarks].get32bitColour()));
00389   
00390   for(double level = 0.0; level <= yMaximum; level += markSpacing)
00391   {
00392    const int y = zero - level * pixelFactor;
00393       
00394    if((((labelHop <= 1) || ((mark % labelHop) == 0)) && 
00395       (mark > 0) && 
00396       ((level+markSpacing) <= yMaximum))
00397    ) {
00398     //g.drawHorizontalLine(y, 0, markYWidth * 1.5);
00399     g.drawLine(0, y - 0.5f, markYWidth * 1.5, y - 0.5f, 1.f);
00400     if(scaleY != ScopeGUI::LabelYMarks)
00401     {
00402      g.setColour(Colour(colours[TextY].get32bitColour()));
00403      g.drawSingleLineText(String(sign * level, decimalPlaces), labelOffsetX, y + labelOffsetY);
00404      g.setColour(Colour(colours[LabelMarks].get32bitColour()));
00405     }
00406    }
00407    else
00408    {
00409     //g.drawHorizontalLine(y, 0, markYWidth);
00410     g.drawLine(0, y - 0.5f, markYWidth, y - 0.5f, 1.f);
00411    }
00412    
00413    mark++;
00414   }
00415  }
00416 }

00418 void ScopeComponent::paintChannelLabel(Graphics& g, Text const& label, const int index, const int top)
00419 {

00421  {
00422   const int size = 256;

00424   
00425   if(label.length() == 0)
00426   {
00427    snprintf(labelToPaint, size, "Ch%d", index + channelLabelOffset);
00428   }
00429   else
00430   {
00431    snprintf(labelToPaint, size, (const char*)label, index + channelLabelOffset);
00432   }
00433   
00434   g.setFont(textSizeChannel);
00435   g.setColour(Colour(colours[TextChannel].get32bitColour()));
00436   
00437   const int left = scaleY == ScopeGUI::LabelYNone ? 3 : markYWidth * 1.5 + 3;
00438   
00439   g.drawText(labelToPaint, 
00440        left, 
00441        top + 3, 
00442        getWidth() - left - 3, 
00443        textSizeChannel, 
00444        Justification::right, 
00445        false);
00446  }
00447 }

00475 void RadialScopeComponent::paintBipolar(Graphics& g)
00476 {
00477  const int numChannels = minDrawBuffer.getNumChannels();
00478  
00479  if(numChannels > 0)
00480  {
00481   const int centreX = getCentreX();
00482   const int centreY = getCentreY();
00483   const float innerMargin = min(getLowerMargin(), (float)getRadius());
00484   const int bufferSizeMinus1 = minDrawBuffer.size()-1;
00485   const int channelHeight = (getRadius() - innerMargin) / numChannels;
00486   const int halfChannelHeight = channelHeight / 2;
00487   const int wrapOffset = bufferWrap * minDrawBuffer.size();
00488   
00489   const float halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum = halfChannelHeight / yMaximum;
00490   
00491   for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00492   {
00493    const int minRadius = channelHeight * channel + innerMargin;
00494    const int zeroRadius = minRadius + halfChannelHeight;
00495    const int maxRadius = minRadius + channelHeight;
00496    
00497    // outer
00498    g.setColour(Colour(colours[TopLine].get32bitColour()));
00499    g.drawEllipse(getCentreX()-maxRadius, getCentreY()-maxRadius, maxRadius*2, maxRadius*2, 1);
00500    
00501    paintXScale(g, zeroRadius);
00502    paintYScale(g, zeroRadius, maxRadius);
00503    paintYScale(g, zeroRadius, minRadius);
00504    
00505 //   float oldMinimum = clip2(minDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, 0), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum - 0.5f;
00506 //   float oldMaximum = clip2(maxDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, 0), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum + 0.5f;
00507    float oldMinimum = clip2(minDrawBuffer.wrapAt(channel, 0 + wrapOffset), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum - 0.5f;
00508    float oldMaximum = clip2(maxDrawBuffer.wrapAt(channel, 0 + wrapOffset), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum + 0.5f;
00509    
00510    const double delta = getDelta() * sine.size();
00511    double position = delta;
00512    
00513    // first scope line
00514    g.setColour(Colour(colours[Trace].get32bitColour()));
00515    g.drawVerticalLine(centreX, 
00516           centreY - zeroRadius - oldMaximum, 
00517           centreY - zeroRadius - oldMinimum);
00518    
00519    oldMinimum += 1.f;
00520    oldMaximum -= 1.f;
00521    
00522    for(int i = 1; i < bufferSizeMinus1; i++, position += delta)
00523    {    
00524 //    const float minimum = clip2(minDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, i), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum;
00525 //    const float maximum = clip2(maxDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, i), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum;
00526     const float minimum = clip2(minDrawBuffer.wrapAt(channel, i + wrapOffset), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum;
00527     const float maximum = clip2(maxDrawBuffer.wrapAt(channel, i + wrapOffset), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum;
00528     
00529     float lineTop = max(maximum, oldMinimum);
00530     float lineBottom = min(minimum, oldMaximum);
00531     
00532     if(style_ == ScopeGUI::Bars)
00533     {
00534      if(lineTop < 0.f && lineBottom < 0.f)
00535      {
00536       lineTop = 0.f;
00537       lineBottom = min(lineTop, lineBottom);
00538      }
00539      else if(lineTop > 0.f && lineBottom > 0.f)
00540      {
00541       lineTop = max(lineTop, lineBottom);
00542       lineBottom = 0.f;
00543      }
00544     }
00545     
00546     lineTop = zeroRadius - lineTop;
00547     lineBottom = zeroRadius - lineBottom;
00548         
00549     const float sinAngle = sine.getSampleUnchecked(position);
00550     const float cosAngle = cosine.getSampleUnchecked(position);
00551     
00552     const float startX = sinAngle * lineBottom;
00553     const float startY = cosAngle * lineBottom;
00554     const float endX = sinAngle * lineTop;
00555     const float endY = cosAngle * lineTop;
00556     g.drawLine(centreX + startX, 
00557          centreY - startY, 
00558          centreX + endX, 
00559          centreY - endY);
00560     
00561     oldMinimum = minimum + 0.5f;
00562     oldMaximum = maximum - 0.5f;
00563    }
00564    
00565    //paintChannelLabel(g, channelLabels.wrapAt(channel), channel, top);
00566   } 
00567   
00568   
00569   if(innerMargin > 0)
00570   {   
00571    // inner
00572    g.setColour(Colour(colours[TopLine].get32bitColour()));
00573    g.drawEllipse(getCentreX()-innerMargin, getCentreY()-innerMargin, innerMargin*2, innerMargin*2, 1);
00574   }
00575  }
00576  
00577 }

00579 void RadialScopeComponent::paintXScale(Graphics& g, const int radius)
00580 {
00581  g.setColour(Colour(colours[ZeroLine].get32bitColour()));
00582  
00583  const int diameter = radius*2;
00584  const int centreX = getCentreX();
00585  const int centreY = getCentreY();
00586  
00587  g.drawEllipse(centreX-radius, centreY-radius, diameter, diameter, 1);
00588  
00589  if(scaleX != ScopeGUI::LabelXNone)
00590  {  
00591 //  ugen_assert(bufferWrap == 0.0); // need to upate this function if the waveform is rotated...
00592   
00593   const double audioBufferSize = audioBuffer.size();
00594   const double radiansPerSample = twoPi / audioBufferSize;
00595   const double radiansOffset = bufferWrap * twoPi;
00596   
00597   const int markSpacing = markSpacingX;
00598   const unsigned int labelHop = labelHopX;
00599   
00600   unsigned int mark = 0;
00601 //  const int labelOffsetX = 3;
00602 //  const int labelOffsetY = markXHeight > 5 ? 4 : markXHeight + 1;
00603     
00604   g.setFont(textSizeX);
00605   g.setColour(Colour(colours[LabelMarks].get32bitColour()));
00606   
00607   for(int audioIndex = 0; audioIndex < audioBufferSize; audioIndex += markSpacing)
00608   {   
00609    const float angle = audioIndex * radiansPerSample - radiansOffset;
00610    const float sinAngle = sin(angle);
00611    const float cosAngle = cos(angle);
00612    const float startX = sinAngle * radius;
00613    const float startY = cosAngle * radius;
00614    
00615    if(((labelHop <= 1) || ((mark % labelHop) == 0)))
00616    {    
00617     const float end = radius + markXHeight * 1.5;
00618     const float endX = sinAngle * end;
00619     const float endY = cosAngle * end;
00620     g.drawLine(centreX + startX, 
00621          centreY - startY, 
00622          centreX + endX, 
00623          centreY - endY);
00624     
00625     if(scaleX != ScopeGUI::LabelXMarks && 
00626        (((mark == 0) && (labelFirstX == false)) == false)
00627        ) {
00628      String label;
00629      if(scaleX == ScopeGUI::LabelXTime)
00630      {
00631       label = timeToTimecodeString((audioIndex + offsetSamples) / UGen::getSampleRate());
00632      }
00633      else if((scaleX == ScopeGUI::LabelXFrequency) && (fftSize > 0))
00634      {
00635       const double fftFreq = UGen::getSampleRate() / fftSize;
00636       const double binFreq = (audioIndex + offsetSamples) * fftFreq;
00637       
00638       if(binFreq >= 1000.0)
00639        label = String(binFreq * 0.001, 2) + T("kHz");
00640       else
00641        label = String((int)(binFreq + 0.5)) + T("Hz");
00642      }
00643      else
00644      {
00645       label = String((int)(audioIndex + offsetSamples + 0.5));
00646      }
00647      
00648      g.setColour(Colour(colours[TextX].get32bitColour()));    
00649      const double rotation = -piOverTwo+angle;
00650      //if(angle > pi) rotation += pi;
00651      AffineTransform transform = AffineTransform::identity.rotated(rotation).translated(centreX+endX*1.01, centreY-endY*1.01);
00652      g.drawTextAsPath(label, transform);
00653      g.setColour(Colour(colours[LabelMarks].get32bitColour()));
00654     }
00655    }
00656    else
00657    {    
00658     const float end = radius + markXHeight;
00659     const float endX = sinAngle * end;
00660     const float endY = cosAngle * end;
00661     g.drawLine(centreX + startX, 
00662          centreY - startY, 
00663          centreX + endX, 
00664          centreY - endY);
00665    }
00666    
00667    mark++;
00668   }
00669   
00670  }
00671  
00672 }
